csv_project_name: As-Needed Adminstration & Vehicle Storage Building Project
csv_scope_of_work: Manchester Water Works is seeking information from qualified firms to provide materials testing and inspection services for our upcoming Administration and Vehicle Storage Building, a municipal construction project involving roadway construction, building construction and utility installation. The Selected testing Agent will be responsible for, but not limited to: Field testing: Concrete, asphalt, soils, aggregates, and other construction materials. Laboratory Testing: Compressive strength, gradation analysis, moisture density relationships etc. Inspection Services: Verification of materials compliance with project specifications. Reporting: Timely submission of test results, daily logs, and non-compliant reports. Coordination: Work closely with project manager, contractor and design team.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Materials Testing, Land Use Planning, Analytical/Testing Services, Utility Engineering, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning
csv_comments: '- Project Number: FY26-804-66- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 07/02/2026 05:00 PM EDT
title: As-Needed Administration & Vehicle Storage Building
short_description: Materials testing and inspection services for a municipal administration and vehicle storage building.
project_scope: Municipal construction project for an administration and vehicle storage building including roadway construction, building construction, and utility installation. The tendered scope covers quality control support during construction rather than design; no gross floor area, structural system, spans, or detailed building dimensions are stated.
services: Materials testing and inspection services, including field testing of concrete, asphalt, soils, aggregates, and other construction materials; laboratory testing such as compressive strength, gradation analysis, and moisture-density relationships; inspection services for compliance with specifications; reporting of test results and non-compliance; coordination with project manager, contractor, and design team.
relevance_explanation:
- Tender is for materials testing and inspection, not structural design or planning.
- Project type is an administration and vehicle storage building, which is not a priority typology for sbp.
- No indication of complex, long-span, lightweight, or architecturally demanding structure.
- Disciplines requested focus on testing, inspection, geotechnical, and project management-related services, which are outside sbp's core target scope.
- Clearly closer to construction quality assurance than to engineering design opportunity.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: municipal administration and vehicle storage building with roadway construction and utility installation. No area, volume, structural type, or cost benchmark is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No planning fee or testing-services fee is stated in the source. The notice is for materials testing and inspection services only; no basis for a reliable sbp fee estimate is provided.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms to provide materials testing and inspection services for municipal construction. Specific minimum reference counts, certifications, or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
contracting_authority: City of Manchester Water Works, Manchester, NH, USA. Contact: Philip W. Croasdale. Phone: 603-624-6494. Fax: 603-628-6020. Email: pcroasdale@manchesternh.gov. Website: https://www.manchesternh.gov/Departments/Purchasing/Bid-Opportunities-and-Results
notes: Project number FY26-804-66. Questions deadline: 2026-07-02 05:00 PM EDT. Contract duration: 18 months. Renewable: No. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Although categorized under buildings, the procurement is specifically for testing and inspection services, which makes it strategically irrelevant for sbp.
